item.title: DDS2 Achievement Guide: Full List (39 Achievements Verified)
item.description:
Drug Dealer Simulator 2 has 39 Steam achievements as confirmed on the official Steam page. The base game contains 21 achievements, and there are 2 DLC packs that add 18 more. Tracking sites like TrueAchievements, Steam Hunters, and PlayTracker document the full list with global unlock percentages. I used these sites along with the Steam Community 100% achievement guide to compile accurate unlock conditions.

item.title: DDS2 Hidden and Secret Achievements (Verified via Steam Trackers)
item.description:
DDS2 has several achievements with opaque unlock conditions. By cross-referencing Steam Community guides (including the "EN Achievements 100%" guide), tracking sites like Steam Hunters and PlayTracker, and GameFAQs, I pieced together the requirements for the hardest-to-unlock achievements. This guide focuses on achievements where the unlock condition is not obvious from the name alone.
